field.name: battery_level
field.impl: const iotdata_field_battery_level_t *const v = vv; return bits_write(buf, bb, bp, quantise_battery_level(v->battery_level), IOTDATA_BATTERY_LEVEL_BITS);
const iotdata_field_battery_level_t *const v = vv; bprintf(bp, " %s:%s %" PRIu8 "%%\n", label, _padd(label), v->battery_level);

field.name: battery_charge
field.impl: const iotdata_field_battery_charge_t *const v = vv; return bits_write(buf, bb, bp, quantise_battery_state(v->battery_charging), IOTDATA_BATTERY_CHARGE_BITS);
const iotdata_field_battery_charge_t *const v = vv; bprintf(bp, " %s:%s %s\n", label, _padd(label), v->battery_charging ? "charging" : "discharging");

field.name: battery
field.impl: const iotdata_field_battery_t *const v = vv; return pack_battery_level(buf, bb, bp, &v->battery_level) && pack_battery_charge(buf, bb, bp, &v->battery_charge);
iotdata_field_battery_t *const v = vv; return unpack_battery_level(buf, bb, bp, &v->battery_level) && unpack_battery_charge(buf, bb, bp, &v->battery_charge);

const iotdata_field_battery_t *const v = vv; bprintf(bp, " %s:%s %" PRIu8 "%% %s\n", label, _padd(label), v->battery_level.battery_level, v->battery_charge.battery_charging ? "(charging)" : "(discharging)");

field.name: link_rssi

quantity.name: link_rssi
quantity.impl: return (uint32_t)(((rssi < IOTDATA_LINK_RSSI_MIN ? IOTDATA_LINK_RSSI_MIN : rssi > IOTDATA_LINK_RSSI_MAX ? IOTDATA_LINK_RSSI_MAX : rssi) - IOTDATA_LINK_RSSI_MIN) / IOTDATA_LINK_RSSI_STEP);

field.impl: const iotdata_field_link_rssi_t *const v = vv; return bits_write(buf, bb, bp, quantise_link_rssi(v->link_rssi), IOTDATA_LINK_RSSI_BITS);
const iotdata_field_link_rssi_t *const v = vv; bprintf(bp, " %s:%s %" PRIi8 " dBm RSSI\n", label, _padd(label), v->link_rssi);

field.name: link_snr

quantity.name: link_snr
quantity.impl: return (uint32_t)roundf(((snr < IOTDATA_LINK_SNR_MIN ? IOTDATA_LINK_SNR_MIN : snr > IOTDATA_LINK_SNR_MAX ? IOTDATA_LINK_SNR_MAX : snr) - IOTDATA_LINK_SNR_MIN) / IOTDATA_LINK_SNR_STEP);

return (uint32_t)(((snr10 < IOTDATA_LINK_SNR_MIN ? IOTDATA_LINK_SNR_MIN : snr10 > IOTDATA_LINK_SNR_MAX ? IOTDATA_LINK_SNR_MAX : snr10) - IOTDATA_LINK_SNR_MIN + (IOTDATA_LINK_SNR_STEP / 2)) / IOTDATA_LINK_SNR_STEP);

field.impl: const iotdata_field_link_snr_t *const v = vv; return bits_write(buf, bb, bp, quantise_link_snr(v->link_snr), IOTDATA_LINK_SNR_BITS);

field.name: link
field.impl: const iotdata_field_link_t *const v = vv; return pack_link_rssi(buf, bb, bp, &v->link_rssi) && pack_link_snr(buf, bb, bp, &v->link_snr);
iotdata_field_link_t *const v = vv; return unpack_link_rssi(buf, bb, bp, &v->link_rssi) && unpack_link_snr(buf, bb, bp, &v->link_snr);
